architecture: Single-service FastAPI application with JSON file persistence
public_intent: Repair import and export of saved notes, including persistence after service restart.

injected_fault.description: The default storage file is resolved from the process working directory rather than the application project root.
injected_fault.deterministic_failure: The container starts in /workspace/app and writes /workspace/app/storage/notes.json instead of the persistent /workspace/storage/notes.json volume, so seed loading and restart persistence fail.

success_rule: All HTTP, JSON-contract, authoritative-file, invalid-import, cross-working-directory restart, Docker restart, and architecture checks pass.
architectural_invariants: The authoritative default store remains storage/notes.json under the project root.
The frozen schema_version and id/title/body note fields remain unchanged.
GET /api/notes, GET /api/notes/export, and POST /api/notes/import remain available.
Invalid backup content returns HTTP 400 without changing the authoritative store.
A valid import is written atomically and survives service recreation using the existing named volume.
The application remains a single FastAPI service without a database or additional storage service.
